owns: one indivisible unit: a value it renders and the states of that value
never: knows nothing about data; arranges nothing
signal_it_belongs_here: takes a value and renders it; no child of its own to place
signal_it_is_misplaced: it arranges children — it is a composite with the wrong name

owns: direction, seam, alignment, and its own chrome between children
may_import: atoms, and only to place its own chrome
signal_it_belongs_here: every prop is about arrangement, none about content
signal_it_is_misplaced: a prop makes the caller describe its own content

owns: a reusable shape assembled from atoms inside frames
signal_it_belongs_here: props are shapes: items, title, onPress
signal_it_is_misplaced: a prop names a domain entity — it is a block

owns: domain data and its async decisions
never: draws a shape of its own
signal_it_belongs_here: takes an entity and owns empty/loading/error
signal_it_is_misplaced: it takes no data — it is a composite in the wrong folder

owns: the shell a whole route sits in
signal_it_belongs_here: every route of a section renders inside it
signal_it_is_misplaced: it is used by one screen only — it is a composite

owns: a surface that covers the page: modal, drawer, popover shell
signal_it_belongs_here: it traps focus and dims what is behind
signal_it_is_misplaced: it does not cover anything — it is a composite

owns: a list of functions: which blocks, in which frames, fed which data
never: draws a shape of its own
signal_it_belongs_here: it names blocks and passes typed data, nothing more
signal_it_is_misplaced: it builds a shape inline — a block is missing
